powers.title: Astral Speech
powers.description: You speak with such compelling conviction that others find it difficult to refute your beliefs and claims.
rows: Effect: You gain a +4 power bonus to Diplomacy checks until the end of the encounter.

powers.title: Bless Weapon
powers.description: You recite an ancient prayer to imbue your weapon with the power of pure faith.
rows: Effect: Choose one weapon you are wielding. Until the end of the encounter, you gain a +1 power bonus to attack rolls with that weapon, and it deals 1d6 extra radiant damage on a hit. In addition, you can score a critical hit with the weapon on a roll of 18–20 against creatures vulnerable to radiant damage.

powers.title: Call of Challenge
powers.description: You brandish your weapon and demand that all foes nearby face you in battle.
rows: Target: Each enemy in the burst
Effect: Each target is subject to your divine sanction until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Divine Counter
powers.description: The power of your god deflects part of an attack against you, and you call out the attacker.
rows: Trigger: An enemy hits your Fortitude, Reflex, or Will
Effect: You take only half damage from the triggering enemy's attack, and the triggering enemy is subject to your divine sanction until the end of its next turn.

powers.title: Kord's Strength
powers.description: Kord answers your shouted prayer with strength and power, causing you to excel in acts of physical might.
rows: Trigger: You would make an Athletics check or an Endurance check

Effect: You gain a +5 power bonus to the triggering skill check. Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +2 power bonus to melee damage rolls, and targets you hit with melee attacks are subject to your divine sanction until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Martyr's Blessing
powers.description: You step into an attack made against an adjacent ally to save your comrade.
rows: Trigger: An adjacent ally is hit by a melee or a ranged attack
Effect: You are hit by the attack instead.

powers.title: Restore Vitality
powers.description: You lay your hands upon an ally, invoking the power of your virtue to restore a comrade to health and remove hindering effects.
rows: Target: One creature
Effect: The target regains hit points equal to your healing surge value and can make a saving throw.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms.

powers.title: Sacred Circle
powers.description: You trace a circle around you with your hand, and it quickly expands into a wide circle of faintly glowing runes that glows brightly and protects you and your close allies.
rows: Effect: The burst creates a zone that, until the end of the encounter, gives you and allies within it a +1 power bonus to AC.

powers.title: Touch of Grace
powers.description: You take onto yourself the suffering of your ally.
rows: Target: One ally
Effect: You transfer to yourself one effect on the target that a save can end.

powers.title: Vice's Reward
powers.description: Your vice buoys your heart, and you revel in the power it provides.
rows: Effect: You gain 5 temporary hit points, and you can make a saving throw. In addition, you gain a +2 power bonus to all defenses until the end of your next turn.
Level 11: 10 temporary hit points.
Level 21: 15 temporary hit points.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of Shadow, page(s) 38.

powers.title: Virtue
powers.description: You gird yourself in your high ideals and face the enemy with renewed determination.
rows: Effect: You spend a healing surge but regain no hit points. You instead gain temporary hit points equal to your healing surge value.

powers.title: Aspect of Domination
powers.description: You radiate crushing dread so powerful that your enemies cannot bear to be near you.
rows: Effect: Until the end of the encounter, when you hit any enemy with an at-will melee attack, you also push that target up to a number of squares equal to your Charisma.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of Shadow, page(s) 40.

powers.title: Aspect of Ferocity
powers.description: The blood of wounded foes feeds your anger, empowering your blows.
rows: Effect: Until the end of the encounter, your melee weapon attacks deal 1[W] extra damage when you are adjacent to at least one bloodied creature.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of Shadow, page(s) 40.

powers.title: Bond of Protection
powers.description: You create a spiritual link between yourself and an ally that allows you to partially shield your friend from harm.
rows: Target: One ally in the burst

Effect: Until the end of the encounter, the target gains a +2 power bonus to all defenses and a +5 power bonus to Endurance checks. In addition, whenever the target takes damage, you can reduce that damage by 5 as a free action. If you do so, you take 5 damage. This damage ignores your immunities and resistances.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms.

powers.title: Divine Bodyguard
powers.description: As your weapon connects with your enemies, so too does the magic of your god connect you to your allies.
rows: Effect: Choose an ally within 5 squares of you. You take half that ally's damage until the end of the encounter or until you end the effect as a free action. No power or effect can reduce the damage you take from this power.

powers.title: Fear Not
powers.description: You reassure your ally, conferring divine power to throw off ill effects.
rows: Target: One creature
Effect: The target can make a saving throw. Against a fear effect, the target gains a bonus to the saving throw equal to your Wisdom.

powers.title: Flare of Divine Vengeance
powers.description: The energy of your divine challenge erupts with light that heals you as the enemy attacks and empowers your next strike against it.
rows: Trigger: The target of your divine challenge hits you
Effect: You can spend a healing surge. You gain a +2 power bonus to attack rolls against the triggering enemy until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Fury of the Battle God
powers.description: Failure breeds frustration and frustration breeds unchecked fury, which you channel into your ability to wound your foes.
rows: Trigger: You miss a target with a paladin encounter or daily attack power

Effect: The targets you missed with the power are subject to your divine sanction until the end of your next turn. You gain a +2 power bonus to damage rolls on the next attack you make before the end of your next turn.

powers.title: One Heart, One Mind
powers.description: You and your trusted allies form a telepathic bond.
rows: Targets: You and each ally in the burst
Effect: Until the end of the encounter, targets can communicate telepathically with each other out to a range of 20 squares, and your aid another actions give a +4 bonus instead of +2.

powers.title: Pure Devotion
powers.description: The intensity of your faith protects you from your enemy's insidious power.
rows: Trigger: An enemy attacks you
Effect: You gain a +4 power bonus to Fortitude and Will until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Shield of Discipline
powers.description: Toughness hard won through years of rigorous self-control blunts your enemies' attacks.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you gain resistance to all damage equal to your Strength.

powers.title: Shield the Virtuous
powers.description: You speak a prayer of protection for an ally, who is surrounded by a shining halo.
rows: Target: One ally in the burst
Effect: Until the end of the encounter, any enemy that hits or misses the target takes 3 + your Charisma radiant damage, unless that enemy is marked by the target.
Level 11: 6 + your Charisma radiant damage.
Level 21: 9 + your Charisma radiant damage.

powers.title: Valiant Rush
powers.description: You plunge into battle with divine speed.
rows: Effect: You move twice your speed to a square adjacent to an enemy that is within your line of sight at the start of this movement.

powers.title: Winter's Fated Stance
powers.description: A murder of ghostly ravens hover about you, warding you against cold and death.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, you gain resist cold and necrotic equal to 5 + your Wisdom or Charisma. You can voluntarily end the stance as a free action to gain +2 to a defense of your choice until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Wrath of the Gods
powers.description: You extend the power of your virtue to nearby allies, enabling you and your friends to easily strike down your enemies.
rows: Targets: You and each ally in the burst
Effect: Until the end of the encounter, each target gains a power bonus to damage rolls equal to your Charisma.
powers.source: Published in Player's Handbook, page(s) 94, Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms, page(s) 128.

powers.title: Beacon of Nobility
powers.description: You inspire hope in your allies through your combination of divine power and valorous words.
rows: Effect: Once per round until the end of the encounter, you can take a minor action to choose an ally within 5 squares of you. That ally gains 5 temporary hit points and a +2 power bonus to the next skill check he or she makes before the end of his or her next turn.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms.

powers.title: Beacon of Penance
powers.description: You sacrifice some of your own vitality to help your allies overcome their wounds.
rows: Effect: Once per round until the end of the encounter, you can take a minor action to restore 10 hit points to one ally within 2 squares of you. If you do so, you take 10 damage. This damage ignores your immunities and resistances.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms.

powers.title: Benediction
powers.description: A quick prayer grants vigor and strength to a comrade in battle.
rows: Trigger: An ally within 5 squares of you hits with a melee attack
Target: The triggering ally
Effect: The target can either spend a healing surge or make two damage rolls for the attack and use either result.

powers.title: Cleansing Spirit
powers.description: A translucent outline briefly appears above the creature you designate. The divine spirit gestures, relieving some of the creature's suffering, then fades instantly away.
rows: Target: You or one ally
Effect: The target makes a saving throw with a +2 bonus.

powers.title: Deathguide's Stance
powers.description: Muttering devotions, you can channel the death that's all around you into life.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, whenever a nonminion enemy within 5 squares of you is bloodied or reduced to 0 hit points, you or an ally within 5 squares of you regains a number of hit points equal to 5 + your Charisma.

powers.title: Deathly Aura
powers.description: The spirit of death surrounds you, nipping at your foes as they are struck.
rows: Effect: You activate an aura 1 that lasts until the end of the encounter. While you are bloodied, enemies in the aura take necrotic damage after they are hit by any attack. The damage equals your Charisma.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of Shadow, page(s) 41.

powers.title: Font of Healing
powers.description: Divine beneficence heals you and your companion.
rows: Target: You and one ally in the burst
Effect: You spend a healing surge, and each target regains hit points equal to your healing surge value.

powers.title: Guiding Verse
powers.description: In the sacred words of a prayer, you find the resolve to shake off a deleterious condition.
rows: Effect: You make a saving throw with a bonus equal to 1 + your Wisdom.

powers.title: Noble Shield
powers.description: You quickly throw up your hand, and a vortex of swirling energy surrounds you and your friends, shielding them from harm at your expense.
rows: Trigger: You are targeted by a close attack or an area attack

Effect: A close attack or an area attack targeting you automatically hits you, and any of your allies who are also hit take only half damage. This power does not change other effects the attack might cause.

powers.title: Righteous Indignation
powers.description: Seeing your ally harmed enrages you.
rows: Trigger: An enemy hits your ally within your line of sight
Effect: The next time you attack before the end of your next turn, you gain a +2 power bonus to the attack roll and deal extra damage equal to 2 + your Strength.

powers.title: Turn of the Dark Tide
powers.description: You whisper a dread word that lets you and your companions sacrifice health to shed an affliction.
rows: Target: You and each ally in the burst
Effect: Each target can take damage equal to one-half his or her level to make a saving throw with a +4 power bonus. The damage cannot be reduced in any way.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of Shadow, page(s) 41.

powers.title: Turn the Tide
powers.description: You whisper a solemn hymn, and divine light washes gently over you and nearby allies, potentially negating harmful and debilitating afflictions.
rows: Targets: You and each ally in the burst
Effect: The targets make saving throws against every effect that a save can end.

powers.title: Vengeful Vigilance
powers.description: Your awareness expands to allow you to protect your allies in an instant, punishing those who would weaken your allies' resolve.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, any time an enemy within 5 squares of you makes an attack that does not include you, you can use divine challenge on that enemy as a free action. If the triggering attack is against Will and you mark the attacker, it immediately takes the damage your divine challenge mark normally deals.

powers.title: Winter's Arrival
powers.description: You step through deep shadow to chase your foe, bringing icy ground back with you.
rows: Effect: You teleport a number of squares equal to 1 + your Charisma, to a space adjacent to an enemy marked by you. All squares adjacent to you are difficult terrain until the end of your next turn.
